migrations.sql:
-- A dedicated write view lets old code keep using its base-table batch during
-- upgrades. Creating it changes no retained sessions, events or counters.
CREATE VIEW respondent_session_progress AS
-- Resolve the parent flow once while materializing a candidate session. The
-- caller still checks its current slug and the step in the pinned revision.
SELECT s.id, s.revision_id, s.session_token_hash, s.completed_at, s.expires_at,
       s.furthest_step_id, s.updated_at, f.slug AS flow_slug
FROM respondent_sessions s
JOIN flow_revisions r ON r.id = s.revision_id
JOIN flows f ON f.id = r.flow_id;

-- Both triggers execute inside the caller's authenticated UPDATE statement.
-- Their order is immaterial: session progress and visit telemetry are disjoint,
-- and a failure in either rolls the whole statement back.
CREATE TRIGGER respondent_session_progress_update
INSTEAD OF UPDATE OF furthest_step_id ON respondent_session_progress
BEGIN
  UPDATE respondent_sessions
  SET furthest_step_id = NEW.furthest_step_id, updated_at = NEW.updated_at
  WHERE id = OLD.id;
END;

CREATE TRIGGER respondent_session_progress_visit
INSTEAD OF UPDATE OF furthest_step_id ON respondent_session_progress
WHEN NEW.furthest_step_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM respondent_session_step_events
  WHERE session_id = OLD.id AND step_stable_id = NEW.furthest_step_id
)
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO revision_step_metric_counters (
    id, revision_id, step_stable_id, reached, dropped, created_at, updated_at
  ) VALUES (
    'step-metric-' || OLD.revision_id || '-' || NEW.furthest_step_id,
    OLD.revision_id, NEW.furthest_step_id, 1, 0, NEW.updated_at, NEW.updated_at
  )
  ON CONFLICT(revision_id, step_stable_id) DO UPDATE
    SET reached = reached + 1, updated_at = excluded.updated_at;

  INSERT INTO respondent_session_step_events (
    id, session_id, revision_id, step_stable_id, counted_at, created_at
  ) VALUES (
    'event-' || OLD.id || '-' || NEW.furthest_step_id,
    OLD.id, OLD.revision_id, NEW.furthest_step_id, NEW.updated_at, NEW.updated_at
  );
END;

migrations.name: 0012_base_invitation_cancellation.sql
migrations.sql:
-- Apply as a NEW numbered migration after operator-auth.sql in existing stores.
-- This durable record is admission state, not an expiring credential. Never prune it.
-- Existing active/inactive operators retain their recorded status: no historical
-- acceptance is inferred. Only a witnessed invited -> inactive transition records
-- an unaccepted cancellation, including direct administrative SQL transitions.
CREATE TABLE oa_invitation_cancellations (
 operator_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES oa_operators(id),
 operator_version INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TRIGGER oa_record_invitation_cancellation AFTER UPDATE OF status ON oa_operators
 WHEN OLD.status='invited' AND NEW.status='inactive'
 BEGIN INSERT INTO oa_invitation_cancellations(operator_id,operator_version)
 VALUES(NEW.id,OLD.version+1)
 ON CONFLICT(operator_id) DO UPDATE SET operator_version=excluded.operator_version; END;
CREATE TRIGGER oa_reject_cancelled_invitation_reactivation BEFORE UPDATE OF status ON oa_operators
 WHEN NEW.status='active' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM oa_invitation_cancellations WHERE operator_id=OLD.id)
 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'invitation_required'); END;

-- validation would not suppress cascading deletes. Copy the parent and its
-- only remaining foreign-key child, then drop the old child before its parent.
-- Responses and session progress use stable step IDs after migrations 0004/0006;
-- branch rules also use stable IDs. None of those tables needs to be rebuilt.
-- https://developers.cloudflare.com/d1/sql-api/foreign-keys/
-- https://www.sqlite.org/lang_altertable.html
CREATE TABLE flow_steps_expanded (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  revision_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES flow_revisions(id),
  position INTEGER NOT NULL,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('welcome', 'question', 'completion')),
  question_type TEXT CHECK(question_type IN ('short_text', 'long_text', 'email', 'single_choice', 'multiple_choice', 'rating', 'priority', 'dropdown', 'yes_no', 'nps', 'number', 'date', 'consent')),
  prompt TEXT NOT NULL,
  helper_text TEXT,
  required INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(required IN (0, 1)),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  stable_id TEXT,
  next_step_stable_id TEXT,
  question_settings_json TEXT,
  UNIQUE(revision_id, position)
);
INSERT INTO flow_steps_expanded (
  id, revision_id, position, kind, question_type, prompt, helper_text, required,
  created_at, updated_at, stable_id, next_step_stable_id, question_settings_json
)
SELECT id, revision_id, position, kind, question_type, prompt, helper_text, required,
  created_at, updated_at, stable_id, next_step_stable_id, question_settings_json
FROM flow_steps;

CREATE TABLE choice_options_expanded (

  step_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES flow_steps_expanded(id),
  value TEXT NOT NULL,
  label TEXT NOT NULL,
  position INTEGER NOT NULL,

  UNIQUE(step_id, position)

  id, step_id, value, label, position, created_at, updated_at, stable_id
)
SELECT id, step_id, value, label, position, created_at, updated_at, stable_id
FROM choice_options;

DROP TABLE choice_options;
DROP TABLE flow_steps;
-- SQLite updates choice_options_expanded's FK when its new parent is renamed.

-- Owned actions (ACT-001 to ACT-008). Actions hold operator-written text and frozen aggregate figures only:
-- no response identifiers, answer excerpts or cohort filters, so response erasure never needs to reach them.
CREATE TABLE actions (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(id),
 title TEXT NOT NULL, rationale TEXT NOT NULL,
 owner_operator_id TEXT REFERENCES operators(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('planned','in_progress','ready_for_review','effective','ineffective','closed')),
 verdict TEXT CHECK(verdict IN ('effective','ineffective')),
 review_date TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(review_date GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]'),
 source TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(source IN ('manual','analysis')),
 analysis_id TEXT,
 metric_name TEXT NOT NULL, metric_unit TEXT NOT NULL,
 metric_direction TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(metric_direction IN ('increase','decrease')),
 baseline_value REAL NOT NULL, baseline_source TEXT NOT NULL, baseline_observed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
 -- Names the history row written with the latest change, so that row is written in the same batch only when the change was.
 last_event_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 created_by_operator_id TEXT REFERENCES operators(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 -- ACT-008: a manual recommendation has no analysis; an action from an analysis must name it.
 CHECK((source = 'manual' AND analysis_id IS NULL) OR (source = 'analysis' AND analysis_id IS NOT NULL))
);
CREATE INDEX actions_workspace_state ON actions(workspace_id, state, review_date);
-- The figures shown when the action was created, kept as they were.
CREATE TABLE action_evidence (
 action_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES actions(id),
 flow_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES flows(id), revision_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES flow_revisions(id),
 question_stable_id TEXT, figures_json TEXT NOT NULL, captured_at TEXT NOT NULL
);
-- Append-only history: creation, every transition and every edit.
CREATE TABLE action_events (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, action_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES actions(id),
 kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('created','transition','edited','measurement')),
 from_state TEXT, to_state TEXT, note TEXT, changes_json TEXT,
 operator_id TEXT REFERENCES operators(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX action_events_action ON action_events(action_id, created_at, id);
CREATE TABLE action_measurements (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, action_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES actions(id),
 flow_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES flows(id), revision_id TEXT REFERENCES flow_revisions(id),
 observed_value REAL NOT NULL, unit TEXT NOT NULL, observed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 operator_id TEXT REFERENCES operators(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX action_measurements_action ON action_measurements(action_id, created_at, id);
-- One external task per action: one idempotency key for its whole life (ACT-003, ACT-007).
CREATE TABLE action_task_deliveries (
 action_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES actions(id),
 idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('pending','confirmed','unknown','failed')),
 payload_json TEXT NOT NULL, payload_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, action_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
 confirmed_by_operator_id TEXT REFERENCES operators(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, confirmed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 in_flight_attempt_id TEXT, remote_task_id TEXT, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);
-- One row per attempt, written before the call; its outcome is written once afterwards.
CREATE TABLE action_task_attempts (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, action_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES action_task_deliveries(action_id),
 ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL, payload_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
 operator_id TEXT REFERENCES operators(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, started_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 outcome TEXT CHECK(outcome IN ('confirmed','failed','unknown')),
 outcome_class TEXT CHECK(outcome_class IN ('2xx','3xx','4xx','5xx','invalid-response','timeout','network','refused','abandoned')),
 http_status INTEGER, remote_task_id TEXT, finished_at TEXT,
 UNIQUE(action_id, ordinal)
);

-- Pencil's restore checkpoint. Every erasure batch (a response, imported or not, and an Audience contact) advances
-- the epoch, and import-kit's retirement carries the same statement as its checkpoint. `rer import --journal LATER`
-- refuses, whole, an archive whose epoch is older than LATER's, so nothing erased after it was made comes back.
-- The row is created by the first erasure; an installation that never erased anything has epoch 0. Additive only.
CREATE TABLE restore_erasure_checkpoint (
  singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1),
  epoch INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(epoch>0)
);

-- ANLY-001..008, 010..016: grounded analysis runs. Additive only.
-- A run fixes its evidence (the exact released response IDs of one published revision) and its policy snapshot when
-- it is requested. Themes, members, quotes and the one recommendation are written only after Pencil validated the
-- provider's answer against that evidence; counts are always recomputed from analysis_theme_members.

-- The workspace's current policies: analysis.autorun.v1, analysis.disclosure.v1, recommendation.selection.v1.
-- A missing row means the defaults (autorun on close at 5 completed responses, threshold 5, highest impact).
CREATE TABLE analysis_policies (
  workspace_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES workspaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  autorun_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(autorun_enabled IN (0,1)),
  autorun_minimum INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 5 CHECK(autorun_minimum BETWEEN 1 AND 100000),
  disclosure_threshold INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 5 CHECK(disclosure_threshold BETWEEN 1 AND 1000),
  selection TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'highest-impact' CHECK(selection IN ('highest-impact')),
  updated_by_operator_id TEXT,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE analysis_runs (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  flow_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  revision_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  trigger TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(trigger IN ('operator','autorun')),
  requested_by_operator_id TEXT,
  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('queued','running','completed','insufficient_evidence','failed')),
  question_ids_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(question_ids_json)),
  policy_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(policy_json)),
  evidence_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(evidence_count >= 0),
  evidence_cutoff TEXT NOT NULL,
  request_sha256 TEXT,
  provider_origin TEXT,
  model TEXT,
  attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(attempts BETWEEN 0 AND 4),
  first_attempt_at TEXT,
  next_attempt_at TEXT,
  lease_until TEXT,
  error_code TEXT,
  error_message TEXT,
  insufficient_reason TEXT,
  summary TEXT,
  redacted_at TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  started_at TEXT,
  finished_at TEXT,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX analysis_runs_workspace ON analysis_runs(workspace_id, created_at);
CREATE INDEX analysis_runs_due ON analysis_runs(state, next_attempt_at);
-- analysis.autorun.v1 runs at most once per closed revision.
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX analysis_runs_autorun ON analysis_runs(revision_id) WHERE trigger = 'autorun';

CREATE TABLE analysis_evidence (
  run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES analysis_runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  response_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  position INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY(run_id, response_id)
);
CREATE INDEX analysis_evidence_response ON analysis_evidence(response_id);

CREATE TABLE analysis_themes (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES analysis_runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  rank INTEGER NOT NULL,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  summary TEXT,
  is_primary INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(is_primary IN (0,1)),
  UNIQUE(run_id, rank)
);
CREATE TABLE analysis_theme_members (
  theme_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES analysis_themes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  response_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY(theme_id, response_id)
);
CREATE INDEX analysis_theme_members_response ON analysis_theme_members(response_id);
CREATE TABLE analysis_quotes (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  theme_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES analysis_themes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  response_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  question_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  start_offset INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(start_offset >= 0),
  end_offset INTEGER NOT NULL,
  excerpt TEXT NOT NULL,
  CHECK(end_offset > start_offset)
);
CREATE INDEX analysis_quotes_response ON analysis_quotes(response_id);

CREATE TABLE analysis_recommendations (
  run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES analysis_runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  rationale TEXT,
  theme_ids_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(theme_ids_json)),
  confidence TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(confidence IN ('low','medium','high')),
  expected_impact TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(expected_impact IN ('low','medium','high')),
  effort TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(effort IN ('low','medium','high'))
);

-- ANLY-010: one row per provider call. Cost is the linked service's receipt, the owner's rates times usage, or null.
CREATE TABLE analysis_calls (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  feature TEXT NOT NULL,
  provider TEXT NOT NULL,
  provider_origin TEXT NOT NULL,
  model TEXT NOT NULL,
  attempt INTEGER NOT NULL,
  outcome TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(outcome IN ('answered','failed')),
  error_code TEXT,
  input_tokens INTEGER,
  output_tokens INTEGER,
  cost_microusd INTEGER,
  cost_source TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(cost_source IN ('receipt','rates','not-reported')),
  receipt_id TEXT,
  day TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX analysis_calls_day ON analysis_calls(workspace_id, day, feature);

-- Base ai's local development capture (modules/ai/dev/outbox.mjs), created here so its schema is committed; its rows
-- never travel in archives.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS rer_ai_development_outbox (
  sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, record TEXT NOT NULL
);

-- One-time owner sign-in links minted by `rer signin` with the deployment's own
-- Cloudflare credentials, written straight into this table through the D1 API.
-- Apply as a NEW numbered migration under the seed's next unused number; never
-- rewrite an applied migration. Additive only. token_hash is the SHA-256 of the
-- link token (owner-signin-grant.mjs); the token itself is never stored.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oa_owner_signins (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, token_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 operator_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES oa_operators(id), operator_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
 created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL, consumed_at INTEGER
);

recovery: Preserve the private deployment receipt and ordered D1 migration ledger. Export before upgrades. Restore to an empty installation; imported historical responses never replay mail. Verify the owner, forms and retained responses before switching traffic.
